name: openclaw-nutrition-coach
description: OpenClaw nutrition coach with Telegram meal logging, scheduled reminders, macro tracking, and a private MCP-backed ledger.

interface.shortDescription: Telegram nutrition coach with MCP-backed meal, macro, water, step, and weight logs.
interface.longDescription: A self-hosted OpenClaw nutrition coach plugin. It includes a nutrition-coach skill, a Node MCP server, and a Dockerized private backend for food logs, macros, targets, reminders, scorecards, and household-aware preferences.
defaultPrompt: Log this meal and update my macros.
